items.text: We're flying to Lisbon for my cousin's wedding on June 14 and coming back the 18th. There are four of us: me, my wife, and our two kids (ages 7 and 11). The wedding itself is at Quinta dos Arcos in Sintra on the 15th, so we'd want a hotel that isn't too far from there but still close enough to the city. Can you suggest a few options with prices, and something for the kids to do on the off day?

intent.requested_action: suggest hotels and activities for a Lisbon wedding trip

items.text: Need to file a travel insurance claim for a canceled flight to the sales conference in Chicago last month — what documents do I usually need to give the insurer?
Reminder that the quarterly sales kickoff is in Barcelona the week of March 10, so please book me a window seat on the morning flight from Dublin that Monday.

intent.requested_action: book a morning flight to Barcelona on March 10

items.text:
I'm planning a honeymoon for late September and could use some help narrowing things down. We like hiking and good food more than beaches, and we have about ten days and a budget of roughly $4,000 for flights and hotels combined.

So far I've been looking at northern Portugal and the Slovenian Alps. Honestly, I find the whole thing a bit overwhelming, which is probably why I keep asking that travel chatbot on the airline site the same questions over and over. Could you put together a rough side-by-side of the two with typical flight costs from Toronto and a couple of hotel suggestions each?

One more thing: our wedding is August 30, so we can't leave before the 31st. My fiancée's parents are covering the flights as a gift, so we'll probably need receipts separated out for that part.

intent.requested_action: compare two honeymoon destinations with costs and hotels

items.text: Does the insurance policy I bought with the December trip cover delays caused by strikes, or only weather?

intent.requested_action: check insurance coverage for strike delays

items.text: For the Q3 sales offsite we're doing a two-day workshop in Edinburgh in November, around 30 people. I need a hotel with a meeting room that holds 30 and a dinner space for the first night. Most people are flying in from London and Manchester, so anything within walking distance of Waverley station would be ideal. Our finance team wants the whole thing under £18,000 including rooms and meals. The automated booking tool we used last year kept flagging the room rate as out of policy, so I'd rather get a couple of options first and check with finance before anything is reserved.

intent.requested_action: find Edinburgh venue options for a sales offsite

items.text: Can you rebook my return flight from Rome to Saturday the 22nd instead of Sunday? Same airline if possible.

intent.requested_action: rebook return flight to Saturday the 22nd

items.text: Quick update on the wedding travel — we've now got 14 guests confirmed for the Malta trip in May, mostly from the UK and one couple from Toronto. The venue has a block of rooms at the Corinthia but it's pricey, so I'd like to offer people a cheaper alternative nearby too. Could you pull together a short email I can send to the group with both options and the booking deadlines? Also, my aunt asked whether the travel insurance we're suggesting for the group covers pre-existing conditions, and I genuinely don't know — maybe worth a line in the email telling people to check with their own insurer.

intent.requested_action: draft a group email with hotel options and insurance note

items.text: What's the typical cost of trip cancellation insurance for a two-week trip to Japan in April?

intent.requested_action: estimate cancellation insurance cost for Japan trip
